nodes.title: Treat Airbnb Bevestigingscode as an opaque string in grouping so numeric-looking codes aren't coerced (F2, 1 failing test)
nodes.rootCause: test_str_airbnb_parser_grouping_property.py::TestAirbnbGroupingProperty::test_one_booking_per_code_payout_excluded fails 'assert {"0.0"} == {"0000E0"}'. Hypothesis minimised a falsifying example with Bevestigingscode='0000E0' (looks like scientific notation -> 0.0). process_airbnb_multi groups by Bevestigingscode; somewhere the group key is passed through numeric coercion (float/Decimal round-trip or dtype inference, e.g. pandas read_csv inferring the column as float), turning '0000E0' into '0.0' so the produced key no longer matches the original string. DETERMINISTIC/reproducible via @reproduce_failure('6.92.1', b'AAEBAAEAAQABAAEOAQAAAAAB'); NOT a deadline/flaky non-determinism issue (derandomize/deadline remedy does NOT apply). Fix in the PARSER: read and use the confirmation code as a stripped string end-to-end, never float()/int()/Decimal() it, force dtype=str for that column if a numeric-inferring reader is involved. Keep the test assertion as-is (airbnb-export-format-update Property 3 treats the code as a verbatim identifier string).
